name: ai/key/save
description: Save an API key for a cloud AI provider. Persists to ~/.continuum/config.env, sets process.env, and emits system:config:key-added event to trigger persona creation.

params.name: value
params.description: The API key value to save

results.name: saved
results.description: Whether the key was saved successfully

results.name: provider
results.description: The config key name that was saved
